sentences.pinyin: Jiàoshījié kuài dào le, Xiǎomíng xiǎng xièxiè tā de shùxué lǎoshī.
sentences.english: Teacher's Day is coming soon, and Xiaoming wants to thank his math teacher.

sentences.pinyin: Yīnwèi Xiǎomíng shàng gè yuè de shùxué kǎoshì bù tài hǎo, suǒyǐ lǎoshī měitiān fàngxué yǐhòu dōu nàixīn de bāngzhù tā.
sentences.english: Because Xiaoming's math exam last month was not very good, the teacher patiently helped him every day after school.

sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī jiāo de hěn rènzhēn, Xiǎomíng de shùxué yě yuè lái yuè hǎo le.
sentences.english: The teacher taught very seriously, and Xiaoming's math is getting better and better.

sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng duì jiějiě Lìlì shuō: "Jiàoshījié kuài dào le, wǒ xiǎng xièxiè lǎoshī, kěshì wǒ bù zhīdào yīnggāi sòng shénme."
sentences.english: Xiaoming said to his sister Lili: "Teacher's Day is coming soon, and I want to thank the teacher, but I don't know what I should give."

sentences.pinyin: Lìlì xiàozhe shuō: "Wǒmen kěyǐ zìjǐ zuò yī zhāng kǎpiàn, zài qù huāyuán zhāi yīxiē xīnxiān de huā."
sentences.english: Lili said with a smile: "We can make a card ourselves and then go to the garden to pick some fresh flowers."

sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng gāoxìng de shuō: "Tài hǎo le! Jiějiě, wǒmen yīqǐ zuò ba."
sentences.english: Xiaoming said happily: "Great! Sister, let's do it together."

sentences.pinyin: Nàtiān xiàwǔ, tāmen yīqǐ zuò hǎo le yī zhāng měilì de kǎpiàn.
sentences.english: That afternoon, they finished a beautiful card together.

sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng zài kǎpiàn shàng xiě: "Lǎoshī, xièxiè nín nàixīn de bāngzhù wǒ, zhù nín jiàoshījié kuàilè!"
sentences.english: Xiaoming wrote on the card: "Teacher, thank you for your patient help, I wish you a happy Teacher's Day!"

sentences.pinyin: Ránhòu, tāmen yīqǐ qù huāyuán zhāi huā.
sentences.english: Then, they went to the garden to pick flowers together.

sentences.pinyin: Huāyuán lǐ de huā yòu duō yòu piàoliang, Xiǎomíng xuǎn le zuì piàoliang de jǐ duǒ.
sentences.english: The flowers in the garden were many and beautiful, and Xiaoming chose a few of the most beautiful ones.

sentences.pinyin: Jiǔyuè shí hào zǎoshang, Xiǎomíng dàizhe kǎpiàn hé huā láidào xuéxiào.
sentences.english: On the morning of September 10th, Xiaoming came to school with the card and flowers.

sentences.pinyin: Tā bǎ lǐwù sòng gěi lǎoshī, rènzhēn de shuō: "Lǎoshī, zhè shì wǒ hé jiějiě zuò de, xièxiè nín!"
sentences.english: He gave the gift to the teacher and said seriously: "Teacher, this was made by my sister and me, thank you!"

sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī wēixiàozhe jiēguò lǐwù, shuō: "Xiǎomíng, nǐ zhēnshì gè hǎo háizi. Qíshí, nǐ de nǔlì jiùshì duì lǎoshī zuì hǎo de gǎnxiè."
sentences.english: The teacher smiled as she took the gift and said: "Xiaoming, you are such a good child. In fact, your hard work is the best thanks to the teacher."

sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng tīng le, kāixīn de xiào le.
sentences.english: Xiaoming heard this and smiled happily.

sentences.pinyin: Cóng nàtiān qǐ, Xiǎomíng xuéxí gèng nǔlì le.
sentences.english: From that day on, Xiaoming studied even harder.

sentences.pinyin: Tā zhīdào, nǔlì jiùshì duì lǎoshī zuì hǎo de gǎnxiè.
sentences.english: He knew that hard work was the best thanks to the teacher.
